question: Which Act was enacted in India with the aim of curbing illegal trade in wildlife and derivative parts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wildlife Protection Act, 1972**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Wildlife Protection Act, 1972**

 
 
• The** Indian Parliament enacted the Wildlife (Protection) Act in 1972 **with the aim of **curbing illegal trade in wildlife and derivative parts**.
 
• In order to safeguard environmental and ecological security, this Act provides for the protection of the nation&am
